name: How much does it cost to remodel a bathroom for senior accessibility?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remodel a bathroom for senior accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to remodel a bathroom for senior accessibility varies widely based on the scope of work and chosen materials. Basic modifications like installing grab bars and a raised toilet can be relatively inexpensive. More extensive projects, such as creating a curbless shower, widening the doorway, or repositioning fixtures for wheelchair access, will incur higher costs. Material selections, from standard tiles to custom finishes, also influence the overall budget. A detailed estimate from a contractor can provide a more accurate cost for specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom accessibility remodeling costs vary based on modifications, from inexpensive grab bars to more costly curbless showers and wider doorways.
